en: Black‑and‑white view over a European village with steep‑roofed houses clustered around a large Gothic‑style stone church with a tall spire and tower. A small round tower-like structure stands nearby, and behind the settlement rises a wooded hill with a small structure or lookout on its summit. The buildings have timber or masonry construction with shingled or tiled roofs, fenced gardens, and a cart in the foreground field. There is no visible printed caption or handwriting on the image side.
